newsitem.title: UK: Alcan Europe announces new management structure.
newsitem.headline: Alcan Europe announces new management structure.

text.p: Alcan Europe, a subsidiary of Canada's Alcan Aluminium Ltd, said Wednesday it re-organised its European management structure.
In a release, Alcan said the objectives of the re-organisation were to create an integrated European manufacturing group in order to optimise and streamline its major sheet rolling assets.
"These assets, currently under different national management, will be placed under one leadership," it said.
It also intends to further develop the customer focus of the organisation by grouping all the assets serving the same markets.

"We have created a new integrated European organisation to achieve the full business potential of our European assets and to improve customer service throughout Europe," Alcan Europe Executive Vice-President Jean-Pierre Ergas said.
Alcan Europe has revenues of $2.5 billion, and is involved in smelting, packaging, rolling and re-cycling.
